lines.en: Guarding the woods, arrows at the ready.
Light steps, wandering through the forest.
I walk a round along the village wall.
My quiver sways on my back.
My bow's slack, ready to string.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子巡逻。
lines.en: I patrol over my own shadow.
One more round before the watch changes.
My boots are muddy from the fields.
Idle thoughts, when the arrow rain comes.
Waiting for a chance, one shot, two kills.
Idle times, bow by my side.

lines.zh: 绿宝石是我财富，弓箭是守护。
lines.en: Emeralds my wealth, bow my protection.
Arrow rain not yet, I am at ease.
Arrows in abundance, mind at ease.
I count how many arrows remain.
I lean on the fence in the sun.
I listen to the village smith hammering.
I tuck my emeralds into an inner pocket.
A crow calls in the distance.
Focusing on you, one shot kill.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，我皆了然。

lines.en: Aiming at you, preparing to shoot.
Keep your hands off my quiver.

lines.zh: 左臂抬不起来了，弓还在。
lines.en: My left arm will not lift, but the bow is still mine.

lines.zh: 我退后不是怕，是要拉弓。
lines.en: I back off to draw, not from fear.

lines.zh: 给我半个面包，我还能拉弓。
lines.en: Give me half a loaf and I can still draw.

lines.zh: 箭袋上多了个洞，没伤到人。
lines.en: A hole in my quiver, but it missed me.

lines.zh: 弓箭闪烁绿光，引诱我靠近。
我的箭矢吸引你的注意。
绿宝石的光芒让我心动。
绿宝石的诱惑无法抵挡。
lines.en: Emeralds' allure is hard to resist.

lines.zh: 我的箭矢是猎人的渴望。
lines.en: My arrows are the hunter's desire.

lines.zh: 我被绿宝石的光芒吸引。
lines.en: I am drawn by the emeralds.

lines.zh: 绿宝石的光芒让我无法忽视。

lines.en: Pay more and I'll take another shift.
Five emeralds; who do I shoot?
At that price, I'll make each arrow count.
One more emerald and I guard till dawn.

lines.zh: 碰撞中我们的箭矢交织。
lines.en: Our arrows intertwine in the collision.

lines.zh: 我们的箭矢在空中相遇。
我们的箭矢在空中碰撞。

lines.en: Our arrows cross in the collision.
The collision knocks our arrows down.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣弓箭更加精准。
lines.en: My mate's arrows are more precise.
Carry my bow for a mate.
My arrows help me find a mate.
I attract a mate with my arrows.

lines.zh: 弓箭是找到伴侣的工具。
lines.en: Arrows are my tool for a mate.

lines.zh: 弓箭是寻找伴侣的方式。
lines.en: Arrows are a way to find a mate.

lines.zh: 弓箭展示我的伴侣价值。
lines.en: My arrows show my mate's worth.

lines.zh: 弓箭证明我的伴侣关系。
lines.en: My arrows prove my mated status.
I need emeralds for my arrows!
There are many emeralds in the village!
I need to replenish my emeralds!

lines.zh: 绿宝石，我赖以生存的资源！

lines.en: I need to get more emeralds!

lines.zh: 再往前一步，我就退两步。
lines.en: One step closer and I take two steps back.

lines.zh: 我退到墙后，把箭搭上弦。
lines.en: I fall back behind the wall and nock an arrow.

lines.zh: 保持距离，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则会受到攻击！
lines.en: Stay away, or you'll be attacked!

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则你会受伤！
lines.en: Don't come close, or you'll be hurt!

lines.zh: 敌人一近身，我就往后撤箭。
lines.en: When they close in, I back off and shoot.

lines.zh: 我在六十步外，风向正好。
lines.en: I am sixty paces out with the wind just right.

lines.zh: 你走近，我的准头只会更稳。
lines.en: The closer you come, the steadier my aim.
Be careful, my arrows are coming!

lines.zh: 不要靠近，我的箭矢准备好了！
lines.en: Don't come close, my arrows are ready!

lines.zh: 保持距离，否则会受攻击！
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll be attacked!
Too close! I block with my bow!
Back off! I block with my bow!

lines.zh: 从瞭望台跌下，脚踝先着地。
lines.en: I fell from the watchtower and landed on my ankle.

lines.zh: 箭矢穿透了我的身体...，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: The arrow pierced my body — and the drown makes it worse.
The blast knocked me over and slackened my string.

lines.zh: 我退到射程外，再补一箭。
lines.en: I back out of reach and loose another arrow.

lines.zh: 我被击中了...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I got hit — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷打过我的铁盔，耳朵还在响。
lines.en: Lightning struck my iron cap; my ears are still ringing.

lines.zh: 坠入虚空...漆黑吞噬了我...
lines.en: Fell into the void... Blackness consumed me...
